title: 8만 명 몰린 짬뽕축제
앉을 곳이 없다
post_title: 8만 명 몰린 짬뽕축제, 앉을 곳이 없다

축제거리.ai: A Korean old downtown street during a food festival, white canopy tents and colorful banners, no people

scenes.text: 8만 명 몰린 짬뽕축제, 앉을 곳이 없다.
이번 달 9일부터 3일 동안, 군산에서 짬뽕 축제가 열렸음.

images.ai: A big bowl of spicy red Korean jjamppong seafood noodle soup with mussels and squid

scenes.text: 근데 짬뽕을 파는 가게는 딱 일곱 곳뿐이었음.
그런데 3일 동안 온 사람이, 무려 7만 9천 명.
3년 전엔 3만 명이었으니, 두 배가 훨씬 넘음.

images.ai: A simple cute bar chart with two bars, a short bar labeled '3만 명' and a very tall bar labeled '8만 명', with an upward arrow

scenes.text: 문제는 짬뽕을 받아도, 앉을 자리가 없었다는 거임.

images.ai: A fictional Korean man in his late 20s with short black hair wearing a plain navy hoodie, holding a bowl of red noodle soup with both hands and looking around confused
A few outdoor folding tables and plastic chairs completely full of people eating, no empty seats
Several people squatting on a sidewalk eating noodle soup from disposable bowls

scenes.text: 뜨거운 짬뽕 그릇을 손에 들고, 바닥에서 후루룩.

images.ai: A fictional Korean man in his late 20s with short black hair wearing a plain navy hoodie, squatting on the ground and slurping red noodle soup from a bowl in his hand, steam rising

scenes.text: 그래서 나온 기사 제목이, 맛있으면 뭐해, 였음.

news.headline: 맛있으면 뭐해… 앉을 곳 없는 짬뽕축제

images.ai: A pile of Korean won banknotes with a big label that says '1억 5천만 원'

scenes.text: 그중 1억 넘게가 행사장 기본 시설에 들어갔다고 함.

images.ai: Festival setup items: white canopy tents, a portable toilet, electric cables and a small stage, simple clip art

scenes.text: 1억 5천으로 8만 명 모았으면, 오히려 가성비 축제라는 거임.

sns.name: 누리꾼
sns.text: 1억 5천으로 8만 명 모았으면 이거 완전 가성비 축제 아님?

images.ai: A fictional Korean man in his late 20s with short black hair wearing a plain navy hoodie, sitting on the ground holding an empty noodle bowl and smiling happily with a satisfied face
